constitutional_invariants: All tangent-space normal vectors must satisfy ||n||_2 == 1.0 with n_z > 0 (OpenGL +Y convention).
Toroidal boundary wrapping (x +- 1 mod W, y +- 1 mod H) guarantees seamless UV tiling across closed 3D manifolds.

mcp_tool_definition.name: synthesize_pbr_material_maps
mcp_tool_definition.description: Generate seamless Albedo, Tangent-Space Normal, Height, and Roughness PBR maps from a luminance matrix or procedural seed.

multi_agent_synthesis_recipe: Stage 1: Extract luminance heightfield from full-resolution EXIF-transposed source photo.
Stage 2: Convolve 3x3 toroidal Sobel-Scharr kernels to derive tangent-space surface gradients.
Stage 3: Bind resulting Normal/Roughness maps to Principled BSDF in headless Blender or Three.js MeshStandardMaterial.
